acceptanceCriteria: A running dispatcher program on macOS and Linux produces admission.json and the doctor reports RUNNABLE_HELD_IDLE and ROLE_QUEUE_DEEP with the documented fields.
bypassFocus and capMax change launches only when set, observed on the live program; the retained logs are attached as evidence.
body: PR #1198 (V1-1914/V1-1916) delivered ATR-V0-150..152 and TQD-V0-043/044 with fixture and unit tests only; live dispatcher qualification on a running program and Linux were NOT_RUN.
title: Live-qualify RUNNABLE_HELD_IDLE, ROLE_QUEUE_DEEP, bypassFocus and capMax on a running dispatcher program (incl. Linux)
